Rebuild the DuckDB database from the journals

Source: R/database.R
fishmorph_build_db.Rd

Idempotent: two successive calls give the same database. The previous database is overwritten (it is a derived artefact), never updated in place.

Usage

fishmorph_build_db(
  journal_dir,
  db_path = NULL,
  export_dir = NULL,
  validate = TRUE,
  stop_on_error = FALSE
)

Arguments

journal_dir

Journal directory (or an already-read long data.frame).

db_path

Path of the .duckdb file. NULL -> no database on disk, everything happens in memory (useful to validate without writing anything).

export_dir

Directory for the Parquet + CSV export. NULL -> no export.

validate

TRUE -> run fishmorph_validate() and attach the report.

stop_on_error

TRUE -> abort if anomalies of severity "error" are detected, BEFORE writing anything.

Value

An invisible list: db_path, n_specimens, n_points, issues.
